question: Has the Maha DBT disbursement GR of 12 October 2018 been changed?
gold_answer: Yes. Paragraphs 8 and 9 amended 30-11-2021. The English and Marathi copies of 12-10-2018 are one GR

product.answer: Yes, the Maha DBT disbursement GR of 12-10-2018 has been amended.
